::: {#fig-device-corner-reference layout-nrow=1 fig-pos="H"}

```{python}
#| label: fig-device-corner-geometry
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 3
#| fig-height: 1.5
#| fig-cap: "Observed marker coupling at `mim-low-c`"
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=13)
    elm.Capacitor().at((0, 0)).to((4, 0)).label('540 fF')
    elm.Dot().at((0, 0)).label('A', loc='left')
    elm.Dot().at((4, 0)).label('B', loc='right')
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-device-corner-model
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 3
#| fig-height: 1.5
#| fig-cap: "Independent model reference at `mim-low-c`"
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=13)
    elm.Capacitor().at((0, 0)).to((4, 0)).label('543.2 fF')
    elm.Dot().at((0, 0)).label('A', loc='left')
    elm.Dot().at((4, 0)).label('B', loc='right')
```

The two values describe the same terminal pair under the same selected C corner, but come from different calculations. The comparison does not add a capacitor to the exported netlist.
:::
